value.title: Phase 1 — contract, units, live proof
value.summary: u0 contract (PM) · u1 Rust · u2 TS · compose · live proof

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Wave 0 freezes the seam; waves 1 run in parallel behind it; the PM composes and runs the live spawn proof.

value.title: u0 — freeze the binding vocabulary + golden fixture
value.success: assets/contracts/register-response.json exists with three samples (created, rebound, same); vocabulary documented in impl-guide unit rows; PM-owned, lands before any coder spawns.
value.notes: Cross-runtime literal seam: both suites READ this file; neither restates the strings.

value.title: u1 — Rust: /v1/register reports binding
value.success: Registry::put (or a sibling) reports inserted vs updated and whether proc changed; register handler returns `binding`; Rust test deserializes the golden fixture; existing tests green.
value.notes: Additive only. seat.put spine kind unchanged. RED first for the new assertion.

value.title: u2 — TS: derive fresh from binding, RED-first witness
value.success: RustSeatDescriptor.binding?: parsed; BootInput.fresh?: override; RustRuntimeSession.boot passes fresh = binding !== 'same'; rust-runtime.test.ts asserts inject(announceText) exactly once for created/rebound and never for same; the test's RED output on the pre-fix tree is pasted into assets/live-proof.md.
value.notes: Do not touch core/session.test.ts. PIJ_ANNOUNCE_TO / task-inject precedence rules in session.ts stay as they are.

value.title: compose + live proof
value.success: Branch composed; daemon rebuilt + restarted (bounce recipe) ; AC1 control-then-fix spawn transcript, AC2 reused-id transcript, AC3 /new+/reload transcript all in assets/live-proof.md; harness checks + cargo gates pasted.
value.notes: Daemon runs from a built binary — restart after the Rust change or the fix is not live (memory: always restart daemon on new build). Bounce refuses on a dirty tree; commit first.

tk-1350.assertion: Fixture file present with 3 samples and cited by path from both suites' source.

tk-1351.assertion: cargo test -p pij-store -p pij-daemon green incl. a fixture-deserialization test; response has binding on every path (create, rebind, same).

tk-1352.assertion: RED output on pre-fix tree pasted; GREEN after; bun test for the extension green; core/session.test.ts diff is empty.

tk-1353.assertion: Live transcripts for AC1–AC3 and full gate outputs recorded in assets/live-proof.md.
